claim: AMA-1.2 R1: extend the promoted AMA-1.1 organism, without adding a parallel assistant, so authenticated or controlled-fixture Mattermost contact is bound to stable principal/team/channel/project scope before payload cognition; exact trajectory, structured capsules, raw artifacts, scoped Chroma recall and unfinished constitutive organization are rehydrated before ordinary cognition; a selected local or explicitly approved remote model participates only through source-bound candidate readings/renderings; and the same live D/Omega/I/W/C, Fact9/flourishing, Generated and native-movement kernel constructs general responses and sustained undertakings across unfamiliar wording, multiple projects/principals, restart, simulated long gaps, edits, duplicates and service degradation. Under a separately approved persistent grant, VoiceRNA-certified effects reach local Mattermost with destination-qualified reconciliation, panic and no replay. The bounded phase closes only through the supported continuously cycling service and preserves concrete formalization feedback for AMA-1.3.
non_claims: This plan alone authorizes no live Mattermost read or write, no historical-message access, no Keychain lookup, no private-memory access, no Chroma request, no model-provider request, no new principal/channel/project, no server mutation, no public deployment, and no reuse of the terminated G31 grant. Offline fixtures and inert request construction may precede a separately frozen and Berton-approved live grant. The phase does not claim universal natural-language understanding, universal appropriateness, complete n-user governance or erasure, universal exactly-once delivery, final VoiceRNA semantics, final 26.6/26.9 mathematics, consciousness, autonomous Soul regeneration, open-ended skill acquisition, or production/SNET release readiness. JavaScript remains builder-side testing only; Prolog remains mechanical; no Python core seam or ~/.miter creation/chown is authorized.
rationale: AMA-1.1 proved the finite constitutive chain in one persistent process, but its ingress is controlled structured contact; its participants are fixtures; its continuity checkpoint contains only the finite active cut; and its effect is a local no-network descriptor. Existing G08-G12 continuity/memory mechanics, G31 Miter-authored Mattermost candidate and reconciliation work, the central model registry, and AMA-1.1 kernel are reusable, but they are separate and some carry gate-specific assumptions. AMA-1.2 is the next unmet dependency because it joins those earned mechanisms through the promoted organism: identity and project scope before cognition, full four-plane continuity, actual bounded semantic participants, general expression, and destination-qualified live use. The route is deliberately integration-first so no second harness architecture or generic LLM wrapper is built.
reading: Read Constitution C-004/008-018, C-020-024, C-030-045, C-050/054-057, C-060-066, C-070-075 and C-098 in full; Soul specification S-102/106, Parts 2, 4-9, 11, 13 and 14, especially S-1301-1304, S-1307, S-1310 and S-1401-1412; Acceptance T-19-24, T-38, T-46, T-52/54/56 and CA-01-09; Work Protocol W-040-044, W-050-060, W-080-087, W-120-127 and W-139; Build Fidelity F-01-09; the active campaign and AMA-1.1 closure. Inspect the exact G08-G12 continuity/memory, G31 identity/candidate/reconciliation, model registry and AMA-1.1 sources. The controlling interpretation is that contact is the movement site of Balance unfolding. Balance is the unfolding movement; Investigation-25 R/A/P makes that movement's participatory organization legible; the nine Immutable Facts make the one becoming finitely legible without reconstructing it; and the nine interconnected flourishings participate in forming what can become possible next. Identity, memory, model and surface products enter that one organization with their actual standing; none supplies an answer outside it and none of Balance, R/A/P, Fact9 or flourishing may be added after movement selection.
representation: Add a scoped AssistantContactEnvelope and ProjectScopeBinding whose stable server/team/channel/principal/thread/post/version identities are mechanically authenticated before payload admission and whose project relation is selected from an explicit scoped registry by native MeTTa, never display names, a model or vector similarity. Extend durable checkpoints with references to an exact ContinuityProjection containing current capsule, canonical trajectory basis, raw-artifact identity, relationship/undertaking/attention/open-alternative state, pending consequence/effect reconciliation and typed availability for semantic memory. Chroma returns VerifiedRecall references only after exact scope filtering and source-hash verification; unavailable or incompatible services produce participant-unavailable records while exact continuity continues. Model requests carry a native purpose, minimal source spans, provenance, scope, role, budget and forbidden authority; responses re-enter as generated participant contributions. General language grounding may use bounded candidate readings, but native relations form/compare continuations. Mattermost effects retain source post/version/thread, destination, stable effect/pending_post identity, prepare/certify/commit/witness state and unknown-outcome reconciliation. Every extension remains joined to the existing ConstitutiveCut and checkpoint schema rather than creating a new conversation state.
consumer: The sole promoted consumer remains AssistantCycle/AssistantEncounter in the continuously cycling PeTTa process launched through bin/miter and the AMA-1.1 operator. Startup must bind configured service identity, verify integrity, rehydrate scoped continuity and reconcile pending effects before admitting ordinary payloads. The assistant reactor requests mechanical identity, capsule/raw/index/model and Mattermost operations through narrow Prolog membranes, receives typed observations, and passes them into the existing native constitutive kernel. The kernel—not the bridge, registry, model, Chroma rank, JavaScript harness or config file—forms and revises movement. The same process persists consequence and K-prime. Controlled fixtures exercise this path before any live grant; the exact same promoted path, not a separate canary, is later used for authorized Mattermost evidence.
falsifiers: The phase fails if a generic LLM chat loop or new surface router bypasses the AMA-1.1 kernel; Balance, R/A/P, Fact9 or flourishing is calculated only after a response, undertaking or act has already been selected; display name, latest message, vector rank, prompt text or model output selects principal, project, memory authority, undertaking or response; continuity restores facts/transcript but loses load-bearing relations, alternatives, attention, consequence or lineage; a changed artifact is ignored or confabulated; Chroma loss becomes amnesia; mixed/revoked scopes leak through retrieval, context, logs or voice; a duplicate/edit/restart becomes duplicate cognition or effect; a pending/unknown Mattermost outcome is blindly retried or mislabeled; the fixed G31 canary/canned acknowledgement remains the response path; participant agreement manufactures independent warrant; a new language/support case needs a scenario rule, RNA species, first-match, score or host branch; Prolog/JavaScript makes semantic choices; live access occurs before the exact grant is approved; or any protected, initial_canon, docs/sources, unrelated G22/G28, ClarityOmega, NRC, secret, model-weight or ~/.miter state changes.
scope_review: R1 authorizes this committed plan, bounded offline implementation and tests in explicitly created /private/tmp roots, plus inert live-grant proposal material that exposes no credential or private payload. It authorizes integration of the exact listed continuity, memory, model and G31 mechanics only through the existing constitutive service. No live HTTP, Keychain, Chroma, LM Studio, OpenRouter or Mattermost call is authorized until a later phase checkpoint presents an exact versioned grant and Berton approves it. Any approved live checkpoint must bind server/team/channel/principal/project and memory scopes, event/history exposure, models/providers, outbound effects, persistence/logging/evidence, rate/resource bounds, lifetime/renewal, panic/revocation/rollback and unknown-outcome handling. Tests never create or chown ~/.miter and never mutate the repository runtime directory or existing ClarityOmega/Chroma collections.
rollback: Before live authority, remove only AMA-1.2 R1 files and restore modified allowed paths to the plan commit; stop only processes identified by an explicit AMA-1.2 isolated-root pid record; preserve all failed evidence and AMA-1.1/G31/G33/G22/G28 history. After an approved live checkpoint, revoke the exact grant, latch panic before stopping the exact bridge/service, reconcile any pending destination identities, return to the verified AMA-1.1-compatible version, and preserve external receipts as historical facts. Rollback never deletes external messages, Chroma canonical sources, private memory, or prior trajectory and never touches ~/.miter.
